meetings.title: Procurement Review
meetings.summary_text: The procurement review covered the stationery contract, the printer leases and the approval limits for purchases made without a second quote. The group agreed to renew the Paper Trail stationery contract for two years, since it is five percent cheaper and reliable, and Owen will confirm with Joanne today. Hannah had already extended the four printer leases until June at the same price, so that matter was settled. The approval limit for purchases without a second quote is to rise from two thousand to five thousand dollars from the first of December.

highlights.text: Paper Trail is five percent cheaper than the other supplier, and its delivery has been reliable.
Hannah's support for the higher limit depends on keeping the register of purchases up to date.
A purchasing card for small items was raised but left for another year.

action_items.description: Confirm the stationery contract renewal with Joanne
Check the renewal terms against the old contract before anyone signs

meetings.title: Board Risk Committee Meeting
meetings.summary_text: The risk committee reviewed the top risks register, cyber security, supplier concentration and the budget contingency. The committee added regulatory change as a fourth top risk, and the Fernwood contingency reserve of two million dollars stays ring-fenced until the November forecast is reviewed. Helen will bring a plan for alternatives to the two most critical services, with estimated costs and timelines, to the next meeting, and Ingrid and Omar will send their papers ahead of the audit committee.

meetings.title: Customer Success Retrospective
meetings.summary_text: The customer success retrospective reviewed the last quarter, covering improved response times and satisfaction, the onboarding delays caused by a lost trainer, and churn patterns among cancelled accounts. The team agreed to reach out to customers at forty-five days of inactivity, before they reach the sixty days seen in cancelled accounts. Follow-up actions were assigned for an inactivity report, a call script, a handover template with the sales team, a follow-up retrospective, and a celebration of the improved satisfaction score.

The team agreed to reach out to customers at forty-five days of inactivity, before they reach the sixty days seen in cancelled accounts.
Follow-up actions were assigned for an inactivity report, a call script, a handover template with the sales team, a follow-up retrospective, and a celebration of the improved satisfaction score.

decisions.text: Customers will be contacted at forty-five days of inactivity, before they reach sixty days.

highlights.text: Satisfaction score rose to eighty-six percent and response times improved.
Several new customers waited more than two weeks for their first training session after a trainer was lost and not quickly backfilled.
The Marlin Point churn review showed most cancelled accounts had not logged in for sixty days before cancelling.
Sales handover sometimes leaves the team unaware of what was promised to customers.

action_items.description: Build the inactivity report and share it
Write the call script for inactivity outreach
Write the draft handover template
Set up a meeting with the sales lead
Book the follow-up retrospective
action_items.due_text: for the end of next quarter

action_items.description: Arrange a celebration of the improved satisfaction score with the team

meetings.title: Security Incident Debrief
meetings.summary_text: The debrief reviewed the Cobalt Reef phishing drill, in which 61 of 400 staff clicked the link and 23 entered credentials, an improvement on the previous drill but still too many. Staff who clicked were mostly on mobile devices, where the sender address is hard to see, so a mobile-visible banner on external emails was proposed. Participants agreed on next steps: Dmitri tests the banner, Beth drafts a reporting reminder for Karim's approval, Karim reports to the executive team, and the next drill is planned for the middle of next quarter.

decisions.text: The next phishing drill will be planned for the middle of next quarter.

highlights.text: Ninety people reported the simulated message, and the fastest report came within four minutes.
Nobody was disciplined, so that staff feel safe reporting.

action_items.description: Test the external email banner on mobile
Draft the reminder about reporting suspicious emails and send it to Karim for approval
Report the results to the executive team

meetings.title: Sustainability Working Group
meetings.summary_text: The first sustainability working group meeting agreed on single-use cups, water refill stations and electronic waste. Single-use cups will be removed from all office kitchens on 1 March 2027, with reception keeping reusable cups for visitors. Owen will obtain quotes for refill stations on every floor and plan installation for the end of January, and a quarterly electronic waste collection day will start on 14 February. Daniel will run a four-week waste audit so the group can measure the difference later, and the group will meet again in four weeks.
